# Tavotto optional component

This directory preserves the Tavotto Codex plugin source from version 0.18.0. The upstream plugin contains references to the full Tavotto repository documentation; those documents are intentionally not vendored here. Read the upstream documentation when changing the plugin:

- <https://github.com/Tavotto/Tavotto>
- <https://github.com/Tavotto/Tavotto/tree/main/codex-plugin>

The code remains under the original AGPL-3.0-only license. It is optional and is not installed by the root `install.ps1` script. Runtime setup, MCP registration, dependencies and project-root authorization are host-specific.
